scope: All regular files outside application, excluding .git/.aws/.agents metadata, symlinks and __pycache__; audit output excluded from its own input inventory.
method: UTF-8 text scan with line-level matches; hashes for all inventoried files and immediate member listings for archives. No rewriting or reinterpretation of historical archive payloads.
preserved_categories: Historical ADRs and feature specs describe the original layout and are superseded by product-bootstrap ADR.
Historical logs, snapshots, hashes and dist packages retain their original paths.
Skill references and SDD templates use generic src/tests/Cargo examples, not the Ox repository layout.
governance_support RELOCATIONS and check-ox archive paths are required for historical recovery.
Root-level Cargo/src/crates test fixtures remain negative cases; current application paths were added as additional cases.
Prompt iniciar-projeto-revisado.md already defines application/crates and correctly warns against workspace-root tests.
limitations: Binary documents are inventoried, not semantically read by the text scan.
Historical archive payloads are preserved; current recursive archive/content checks run separately through governance tooling.
